item.title: Dortmund-Lütgendortmund
item.description:
With our new location in Dortmund-Lütgendortmund we are expanding our offer of senior-friendly living in a family atmosphere. Situated in a quiet residential neighbourhood, the house provides everything that matters for a safe and fulfilling life in older age.

A home with structure and freedom

Our shared home in Lütgendortmund combines self-determined living with needs-based support. Whether shared breakfast, gardening or an outing in the area — residents actively shape their everyday life here.

item.title: Almost there — the first move-in is imminent
item.description:
Only a few days left until the first resident moves into our senior shared home! Final preparations are already in full swing: the photo shows our carpenter “Conny” fitting handrails — small details that make a big difference in everyday life.

We are thrilled about this special moment and about our house finally being filled with life. The first shared cup of coffee, the first laughter at the table — it is all just around the corner.

item.title: Premiere — presenting our first senior shared home in Lütgendortmund
item.description:
On 4 June 2025 I had the chance to present our first senior shared home at the round table of the Seniorenbüro Lütgendortmund.

It was a special moment for me, because it became clear: communal living in older age is more than a trend — it is a real opportunity for quality of life, self-determination and togetherness.

The positive response showed us that our idea meets the spirit of the times. And it encourages us to keep going: creating senior-friendly forms of living that connect heart, mind and everyday practice.

item.title: A big step for us — Kumpel & Hütte UG (limited liability) has been founded!
item.description:
On 6 May 2025 we signed the partnership agreement for our Kumpel & Hütte UG (haftungsbeschränkt) — a moment we celebrate with pride and joy.

“Kumpel & Hütte” is more than just a name for us. It stands for solidarity, honest work, friendship and a place where ideas are born and become reality. These are exactly the values we want to carry into our company.

With the founding we have now laid the foundation to pursue our projects with full strength. For us that means: roll up our sleeves, get stuck in together and build something new with heart and passion.

item.title: Moving in with us
item.description:
Moving in with us — living in community

  1. Home
  2. The home
  3. Moving in with us

Welcome to Kumpel und Hütte!

Here you can learn what living in our communal homes looks like, what requirements apply and how the move-in process works step by step.

Your life in the community

Together instead of alone — with us you can expect

  • Privacy & community: Your own comfortable room plus a generous living kitchen, modern bathroom, garden or balcony and shared living space.
  • Everyday life with heart: Shared meals, activities, celebrations and cultural outings — everything is possible, nothing is mandatory.
  • Individual support: Our team helps where it is needed — from household help through to the nursing care we provide ourselves.
  • Safety & technology: 24/7 emergency call system by arrangement, Wi-Fi and senior-friendly furnishings for a carefree life.
  • Transparent costs: Clear pricing with no hidden fees; financing support through care and social funds may be possible.

item.title: Our motivation
item.description:
Our motivation

  1. Home
  2. Organisation
  3. Our motivation

Why Kumpel und Hütte?

In a world that moves ever faster, where families often live far apart and neighbours barely know each other, many older people slip into social isolation. At Kumpel und Hütte we believe life in older age deserves more: more community, more safety, more dignity. Our motivation comes from the wish to create an alternative to the classic care home — a home that warms, connects and supports without losing individuality.

item.title: Who we are
item.description:
About us

Behind Kumpel und Hütte is a dedicated team of people who share one vision: making life in older age more beautiful, safer and more communal. We come from different fields — opera, ballet, management and investment — but what connects us is the wish to create meaningful housing concepts with genuine humanity. With experience, openness and a real ear for individual needs, we accompany our residents in everyday life — not as mere service providers, but as companions and support.
